title: Manual DR failover process (TC-DR-009)

items.title: Preflight check
items.text: Verify dAG1 and dAG2 are healthy; measure async lag.

items.title: Demote primary
items.text: Set the role to secondary within the distributed AG.

items.title: Promote DR
items.text: Force failover; fcAG1 becomes the global primary.

items.title: Validate DR reads
items.text: Run the read checks against the DR listener.

items.title: Failback
items.text: Set secondary and force failover back to node01.

items.title: Verify restored
items.text: Clients return to the primary listener; DR to standby.

takeaway: Validated June 26, 2026 · forward failover and failback complete

title: Three reasons SQL Server 2025 changes the GCE design

items.title: Distributed contained AGs are now GA
items.text: The metadata drift problem is solved across regions: one pattern gives multi-zone HA and cross-region DR without manual sync runbooks.

items.title: Configurable AG commit time
items.text: A per-replica latency lever for OLTP architects: set 1-5 ms for a p99 improvement on sub-millisecond inter-zone links.

items.title: Standard Edition raised to 32 cores / 256 GB
items.text: Basic AG becomes economic for more workloads and reshapes the Enterprise vs Standard decision for smaller OLTP systems.

title: AG type comparison matrix
takeaway: ★ Recommended: OLTP, multi-zone HA and cross-region DR on GCE with Enterprise Edition
